svg.desc: Start with the ELI16 executive summary, then all fifteen module responsibilities and the exercised dependency maps. M1 established replaceable ports and independent commits; M1.2 connected real Hive; M2 added private memory and guarded revision; M3 adds independent short-term attention and bounded inference over an explicit workset. M3.1 closes delivery seams with separate owner-authoritative progress and no new cognition. Suggested delivery: 45–50 minutes through slide 36; eight appendices support discussion. Evidence is clean tested implementation 1b17d74f2808703894ea55c9539adf264bc87976 recorded by 985d2f34ea8df8c5d93582e4ed6fe5cbe1843074. This deck update does not rerun integration gates or add runtime behavior.
